en.headline: HKU centre reports rise in under-15 suicides despite overall decline
en.dek: On World Suicide Prevention Day the centre estimated 976 suicides in 2025, a rate of 13 per 100,000, while the under-15 rate climbed to a decade high; it also issued updated media guidelines covering social platforms.
body: The University of Hong Kong’s Jockey Club Centre for Suicide Research and Prevention released 2025 figures on Thursday showing an overall decline in suicides but a sharp rise among children under 15.

Using Coroner’s Court data the centre estimated 976 suicides last year, or 13 deaths per 100,000 residents, down from 13.8 in 2024. The rate among people aged 60 and above also fell. However the under-15 rate rose to 2.9 per 100,000, the highest since 2016, with most of the increase among boys.

Director Paul Yip Siu-fai noted that about one-third of under-15 cases involved students from Band 1A schools and that academic pressure and peer relationships were frequently cited factors. He urged schools to give students more time to build relationships in the first weeks of term and called on media and social-media users to follow the centre’s updated reporting recommendations, which now explicitly cover platforms used by young people.

zh.headline: 港大中心：整體自殺率微降 15歲以下個案顯著上升
zh.dek: 世界防止自殺日港大賽馬會防止自殺研究中心公布2025年數據，估計976宗自殺死亡，整體率降至每10萬人13宗，但15歲以下比率升至近十年高位；中心同步更新涵蓋社交媒體的報道建議。
body: 香港大學香港賽馬會防止自殺研究中心周四公布2025年數據，顯示本港整體自殺個案回落，但15歲以下群組顯著上升。
中心根據死因裁判法庭資料估計，去年有976宗自殺死亡，即每10萬人13宗，較2024年的13.8下跌。60歲或以上長者自殺率亦下降。然而15歲以下比率升至每10萬人2.9，為2016年以來最高，升幅主要來自男童。
中心總監葉兆輝指出，約三分一15歲以下個案就讀Band 1A學校，學習壓力及朋輩關係是常見因素。他呼籲學校在開學首兩周讓學生有更多時間建立關係，並促請傳媒及社交媒體用戶遵守中心更新的報道建議，新版明確涵蓋年輕人常用的平台。
